premises.text: Microsatellite customers forced onto shared launches must compromise on schedule, destination, and multi-customer integration constraints
premises.evidence_span: they must compromise on every aspect of the launch

premises.text: Ground-launched rockets cannot be made small enough to cost-effectively serve an individual microsatellite customer because of atmospheric drag
premises.evidence_span: when you launch a rocket from the ground, you can only make it so small while still having enough energy to reach orbit. And unfortunately, at this size, it's just too big and expensive

premises.text: Launching from 60,000 feet above most of Earth's atmosphere enables a roughly half-size rocket for individual customers
premises.evidence_span: By launching at this altitude, we can reduce the size of the rocket to just half of what it would be if we would launch it from the ground

premises.text: Regulus is a fully reusable, autonomous, mobile high-altitude balloon launch platform

premises.text: The platform can deliver dedicated launches within weeks to any low-Earth orbit at high frequency so satellites can operate immediately
